name: Harribance: equal bilateral LTP, 20-s rotation, alternating with no field
origin: Persinger & Koren lab (Laurentian University), later Koren Helmet trials with the psychic Sean Harribance, reported in Persinger 2010
summary: A later Harribance series from Persinger's lab: the same LTP pattern at equal strength on both sides over the parietotemporal regions, with one turn of the four coil pairs taking 20 s instead of 2 s, here alternated with no-field blocks. Persinger 2010 reports that it cut his alpha rhythm to about 25 to 30% of baseline and the accuracy of his readings by about 20% (one subject, not blinded).
notes: Persinger 2010 reports a later series with 'the same longterm potentiation (LTP) pattern' as before, in which one complete cycle of the stimulating solenoid pairs took 20 s 'as compared to 2 sec' (p.11 [454]). Alpha fell 'to about 25% to 30% of baseline' and accuracy 'by about 20%'. The paper gives no number, length or order of trials, and does not say whether alpha was measured during or after the field. This program alternates three 5-min no-field and LTP blocks: this project's choice, so that field and no-field periods can be compared. Each pair is on for 5 s, both sides at equal strength. One left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. The LTP pattern is rebuilt from one sentence, 'a single pulse followed about 170 msec later by 4 pulses in rapid succession with a functional frequency of between 100 and 200 Hz' (p.6 [449]): 1-ms pulses at 0, 170, 180, 190 and 200 ms, repeated every 201 ms, the same table as in persinger-harribance-koren-2s. Pulse width, polarity, the 200-Hz spacing and the repetition rate are this project's choice. The repetition rate is not stated for this series; in the earlier session the interval between repeats was 4 s (Roll 2002 p.9 [204]), which persinger-harribance-koren-2s plays. Intensity is given only as 'in the order of 1 uT', with no place of measurement (p.11 [454]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. One subject, not blinded, and a reported reduction: an anecdote. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated, eyes closed or blindfolded, in a quiet, dark room. In each block, describe a hidden photograph that someone else picked at random, and have a third person rate the descriptions against the photographs without knowing which blocks had the field (use the app's Blind option).
schedule: Several trials with one subject in the original; their number and spacing are not given.
source: Persinger 2010, The Harribance effect as pervasive out-of-body experiences, NeuroQuantology 8(4):444-465, pp. 448-449 and 454 http://web.archive.org/web/20150426091303id_/http://www.neuroquantology.com/index.php/journal/article/download/301/346 ; Persinger & Murphy 2016, Neuroscience & Medicine 7:27-44 (Koren Helmet: four left-right solenoid pairs, 0.5 s each, 2-s cycle) https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/god_helmet_debate_publication.htm ; Persinger & Saroka 2012, Protracted parahippocampal activity associated with Sean Harribance, Int J Yoga 5:140-145 https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3410194/ ; Delparte & Persinger 2007, Int J Neurosci 117:295-299 (LTP field as "1 s pulse of 5 trains") https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17365115/ ; Corradini 2014, MA thesis, Laurentian University (primed-burst LTP file) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/1455e1f3-2f1d-47b5-93cd-23713d69e651 ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1-6 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
